body:
**[comments] Rule 5, a call-site comment says only why here: shorten**

The parenthetical "(in the form that serves both K layouts, Note [K VNNI storage])" restates the set_k_row / get_k_row contract from kv_cache.hpp. The two sentences before it are the test's claim and stay.

Proposed:
```cpp
    // The two slots are distinct storage. A row stored in one is not seen in
    // the other.
```
